title: Set up fresh state
summary: beforeEach runs before each test in its scope. Use it to prepare fresh mutable data.
introduction: beforeEach runs before each test in its scope. Use it to prepare fresh mutable data. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.title: Set up fresh state

blocks.text: The basket starts empty for the test. Another test can change its own fresh basket.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Add a second test that pushes one item.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not rely on another test to clean up your state.
For more detail later, use this [Jest further reading](https://jestjs.io/docs/getting-started).
